page.overview:
Who is Rudo Villano?

Rudo Villano, also known as Max Villano in the United Kingdom, is a villain from the Adventurers Jungle theme introduced in 1999.

Rudo Villano wears a black Safari Hat and has messy, black hair sticking out from under it. His eyes are slanted in an angry expression and a red scar is slashed under his right one. His face is given stubble detailing. Villano wears a dark grey button-up shirt which exposes skin near the top, also revealing chest hair. A cartridge belt is printed above his waist and two revolvers are pushed in it. He has earth orange pants and, in some appearances, also has a matching backpack.

In Tales on the LEGO Express: The Heist, Rudo Villano wears a black neck scarf, covering the lower half of his face.

His appearance in 5784 Soccer Mania is slightly changed. Rather than wearing a fedora, he has a dark grey cap similar to Docs. His torso is also modified; his shirt is now fully unbuttoned, showing a green-and-black striped undershirt, and his two revolvers are absent.
